turns.replyText:
Honestly, is the pricier one worth the extra, or is the cheaper one fine?

It really depends on which two plants you’re looking at and what matters most to you.

Sometimes the higher price reflects things like:

Newer or rarer variety
Stronger disease resistance / lower maintenance
Extra-strong fragrance or unusual color

But in a lot of cases, the more affordable option is completely fine and will still be beautiful in the garden.
